addClaims.text: With risk-based step-up consent, users can't consent to most newly registered multitenant apps that aren't publisher verified.
addClaims.quote: users can't consent to most newly registered multitenant apps that aren't publisher verified

addClaims.text: Publisher verification needs a Partner One ID for a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account.
addClaims.quote: The developer must have a Partner One ID for a valid Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account that has completed the verification process.

addClaims.text: Verified publishers get a blue verified badge on the Entra consent prompt.
addClaims.quote: a blue verified badge appears in the Microsoft Entra consent prompt for the app

addClaims.text: Redirect URIs must use https, with exceptions for some localhost URIs.
addClaims.quote: Redirect URIs must begin with the scheme https , with exceptions for some localhost redirect URIs.
Redirect URIs are case-sensitive and must match the case of the URL path of your running application.

addClaims.text: Tenant admins can allow user consent only for apps from verified publishers (and apps registered in their tenant), so unverified apps may need admin consent.
addClaims.quote: Allow limited user consent only for apps from verified publishers and apps that are registered in your tenant

addClaims.text: By default users can consent to low-risk permissions (e.g. their own mailbox) but not to org-wide permissions, which need an administrator.
addClaims.quote: by default, a user can consent to allow an app to access their mailbox but can't consent to allow an app unfettered access to read and write to all files in your organization

addRequirements.label: Publisher verification via a verified Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program account
addRequirements.when: For multitenant apps whose users are in other organizations' tenants (otherwise consent may be blocked)

addRequirements.label: Tenant admin consent
addRequirements.when: For org-wide (admin-only) permissions, or tenants that restrict user consent to verified publishers

addRedirectRules.rule: HTTPS only (some localhost exceptions); case-sensitive match on the path.

addBlockers.symptom: Users in a customer tenant see 'Need admin approval' / cannot consent to your app
addBlockers.cause: Your multitenant app isn't publisher verified and the tenant restricts user consent (risk-based step-up or verified-publishers-only policy), or you requested admin-only permissions.
addBlockers.fix: Complete publisher verification (CPP account + Partner One ID), request only user-consentable delegated permissions, or ask the tenant admin to grant admin consent.
addBlockers.fallback: Single-tenant app registration inside each customer's tenant for enterprise pilots.

addUncertainties: Exact AADSTS error codes shown to blocked users vary by tenant policy; the blocker's symptom text is paraphrased.
